description: In K-Pop, the Elegant Girl Crush concept acts as the melodic or elegant version of the Girl Crush concept. Often blending grace, poise, lush and accessible elements, melodies and deliveries—to complement the bold and abrasive electronic sound. It is designed to inspire admiration and empowerment in a more mellow way, particularly among female fans.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Confidence, mellow elements, soothing vocals, assertive vocals, female empowerment, independence, charisma, boldness, subversion of traditional gender roles
